T530 mixed chronology owner component.
Combines the attributed T37 chronology with retained T16 chronology, with current PR3605 provider words. No allocation optimizer is shipped.
Finite check: OWNER_SOURCE_REPO=/explicit/source python3 -I -B verify_candidate.py CANDIDATE.json --kind concatenated
Optional deterministic reconstruction: OWNER_SOURCE_REPO=/explicit/source python3 -I -B portable_expand.py --out /fresh/owners
Reconstruction and independent_literal.py do not constitute native or outer admission. Independent literal audit additionally requires OWNER_LITERAL_DIR, OWNER_NATIVE_DIR (checked-base/extra canonical words), OWNER_AUDIT_OUTPUT.
Known T530 literal profile and payload are frozen in EXPECTED.json. No T2220 or predecessor owner receipts are reused as proof. Source interfaces and input pins are checked before evaluation.
Attribution: the integral network and prior T37 source execution are retained from PR3605 and its credited predecessors; the T16 chronology is the PR3413 order retained by our PR3457/3465 provider-composition allocation; T16-PROVENANCE.json pins its main-source PLAN and dispatcher construction. The new certificate mixes these chronologies and uses the changed PR3605 operator inventory. All upstream notices are retained. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
